_comment: Hand-labelled headlines drawn from the live corpus, used to measure
classifier accuracy rather than assert it. Labels reflect what the story
is primarily *about*, not merely which words it contains — the specific
'noise' means the story is not geopolitical news at all. A large share of
the per-country search feeds is sport, entertainment and local crime, so
recognising that is part of the job.
Where a story spans categories the label is its primary thrust:
sanctions are economic statecraft (economy) even when announced at a
summit; an army running earthquake rescues is a disaster story.
